governance.membershipEvidence: TODA certification plus Makati Tricycle Federation (MATRIFED) certification are required in the published City Citizen's Charter for franchise renewal.
governance.routeRule: Makati's Traffic Code treats tricycle permissions as routes or areas of operations, not generic citywide service.

operatingConstraints: Tricycles are not permitted on national roads.
The Traffic Code says routes/areas of operations should consider traffic-safety recommendations.
The Traffic Code says tricycles/pedicabs should not operate along bus or jeepney routes.
Where no off-street terminal/station exists, tricycle numbers may be restricted to reduce congestion.
